purpose: Teach: 宅地/本数/常々/急行/チャージ/有給/待ち時間/少額

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 住宅地、宅地内の見回り、警察、強化中です、市民の安全、本当に、第一です、絶対。
lines.en: We've been strengthening patrols throughout the residential areas. Citizen safety is absolutely our first priority.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Clear diction. Each clause lands with quiet authority. No rush. The assurance of someone who has said this many times and means it every time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、社員、本数、地域防犯活動に、参加させてまいります、絶対に、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. Our company will absolutely commit to participating in local crime prevention efforts.
lines.style: Respectful, formal register. Slight forward lean in the voice. Earnest — not performing, but showing readiness. Clean, crisp agreement without elaboration.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、常々、市民の皆様の、ご協力に、感謝、申し上げております、本当に、絶対、感謝。
lines.en: The police have always been grateful for the cooperation of our citizens. We truly appreciate it.
lines.style: Formal, measured delivery. Slight warmth breaking through the official language. Each phrase receives equal weight — this is a statement meant to be heard and remembered, not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様、急行で、お見送りに、本社、参ります、警察様の、お見守りに、感謝。
lines.en: Yes. We'll ensure our executives personally see off VIP customers. We're genuinely thankful for the police's protection.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly eager tone. Small emphasis on the commitment. Humble but not obsequious. The pace picks up slightly on the thanks — more human, less procedural.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 通信費の警察支給、無駄なチャージ、絶対、避けるよう、徹底中です、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: We're making sure to avoid any waste or unnecessary charges for police-provided communication services.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, detail-oriented. No flourish. The tone of someone responsible for budgets who takes that seriously. Flat, efficient, but carrying quiet diligence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、警察協力で、有給扱い、社員、皆、ご協力、感謝、申し上げております、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Our company treats police cooperation work as paid time, and all staff are grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Formal politeness layered with genuine warmth. The words are official, but the delivery carries real appreciation underneath. Not rushed, but not stiff either.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害届の待ち時間、最小限に、抑えるよう、警察、改善、進めております、本気で、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: We're actively working to minimize wait times for damage reports. We're making real improvements.
lines.style: Determined, forward-focused. Small emphasis on 'actively' and 'real.' The tone of someone invested in making systems better. Professional but carrying quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。少額の被害でも、警察、丁寧に、対応されているのを、感謝しております、本当に、絶対、感謝。
lines.en: Yes. I'm genuinely grateful that the police handle even small claims with such care and attention.
lines.style: Sincere, quiet emphasis. Warmth in the voice — this is felt, not just recited. Slight softening on 'care.' The gratitude lands as real, not ceremonial.
